contracts_rationale: This mission authors no published API or wire contract. The SpecKittyDriver is an internal Java test-harness port, not a published interface; the runner only consumes existing published contracts (e.g. contracts/mission-status/openapi.yaml). No OpenAPI/GraphQL schema is produced.
purpose_context: This mission gives Spec Kitty maintainers a black-box, behaviour-driven acceptance surface for the CLI: Gherkin scenarios kept in-repo and a nightly JVM runner that installs a freshly-built wheel and exercises the CLI as an external user would. It records an owner ruling that promise-sourced scenario tooling belongs to spec-kitty-qa, keeping core responsible only for the scenarios, the runner, and the nightly.
purpose_tldr: Maintainers can write Gherkin acceptance scenarios for the CLI and have them run every night against a wheel built from the commit, on Linux, macOS and Windows.
